# NMG Receives Continued Listing Standard Notification from the New York Stock Exchange


20 November 2026 -


[Leadership](https://nmg.com/category/leadership/) ,[Investing](https://nmg.com/category/investing/) ,[Bécancour](https://nmg.com/category/becancour/) ,[Matawinie](https://nmg.com/category/matawinie/) ,[Press Release](https://nmg.com/category/press/)


**MONTRÉAL, CANADA,** **November 20, 2026 –** Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. (“NMG” or the “Company”) ([NYSE: NMG](https://www.nyse.com/quote/XNYS:NMG) ,[TSX: NOU](https://money.tmx.com/en/quote/NOU) ) announces that it received a written notification (the “Notification Letter”) from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on November 18, 2026, indicating that the Company is not in compliance with Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual because the average closing price of its common shares (the “Shares”) was less than US$1.00 per Share over a consecutive 30 trading-day period.


The Company’s operations are not affected by the receipt of the Notification Letter. In addition, it has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Shares, which will continue to trade on the NYSE under the symbol “NMG”, subject to the Company’s compliance with the NYSE’s other continued listing standards. The Shares are also listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and the Notification Letter does not affect the Company’s compliance status with this listing.


Under Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual, the Company has six months following receipt of the Notification Letter to regain compliance. The Company will regain compliance if, on the last trading day of any calendar month during the six-month cure period, the Shares have a closing price of at least US$1.00 and an average closing price of at least US$1.00 over the 30 trading days preceding the end of that month.


At the end of the six-month cure period, if the Share price has not met the requirement under Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual, the Shares will be subject to NYSE suspension and delisting procedures.


The Company is evaluating available options in response to this Notification Letter.


**About Nouveau Monde Graphite**


Nouveau Monde Graphite is an integrated company developing responsible mining and advanced processing operations to supply the global economy with carbon-neutral advanced graphite materials. The Company is developing in Québec, Canada, a fully integrated ore-to-processed-graphite value chain to serve tomorrow’s industries in energy, advanced technology, and manufacturing. With recognized ESG standards and structuring partnerships with major customers, NMG is set to become a strategic supplier of advanced materials to leading specialized manufacturers while promoting sustainability, innovation, and supply chain traceability.[www.NMG.com](https://nmg.com/) .
